source_finding.g7_condition_derived_projection: MatchedTaskOutcomeReadback.observe_from_g4 currently derives reentry_observed from the arm condition: intervention => true; control => false. The accepted G7 target run therefore proves exact execution/lineage of that bridge and a semantic-difference candidate, but not a non-circular semantic effect.
source_finding.g8_claim_strength: The live G8 claim correctly names this circularity and requires deriving the shared predicate from exact G4-bound GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt and ControlNoBroadcastReadback payloads rather than from arm labels.
source_finding.residual_risk: Even after G8 removes arm-label circularity, REENTRY_OBSERVED is still a mechanism-occurrence predicate. A difference in re-entry occurrence is not by itself evidence that broadcast semantic content changed a task-level semantic outcome.

counterexample.setup: Use a valid exact G4-bound intervention runtime witness with DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY and a valid exact G4-bound no-broadcast control readback, while the actual task-level downstream semantic outcome is equivalent across arms (for example both canonicalize to {decision: ABSTAIN}).
counterexample.possible_false_green: A G8 binder that projects only REENTRY_OBSERVED will still produce true vs false and therefore a semantic difference at the re-entry mechanism schema even though the downstream task semantics are unchanged.

required_g8_regressions: Reject an intervention observation unless the supplied GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt validates with recorder origin and its sha256 exactly equals contract_candidate.runtime_witness_sha256.
Reject a control observation unless the supplied ControlNoBroadcastReadback validates with factory origin and its sha256 exactly equals contract_candidate.control_readback_sha256.
Reject witness/control source, boot, execution-context, downstream-ref or downstream-sha mismatches even when the caller selects the expected arm label.
Reject arm-source swaps: a control readback cannot satisfy intervention evidence and a runtime witness cannot satisfy control evidence.
Preserve a distinct evidence_scope that says observed re-entry/mechanism semantics, not task-semantic content influence.
Add a semantic-equivalent-task-outcome negative control: valid re-entry difference plus equal downstream task semantics must leave semantic_gwt_runtime_credit and jspace_runtime_credit at zero.
Keep all constructor/source-only/repository-CI paths at zero higher credit; exact owner-VPS execution and separate reconciliation remain required for any target-runtime promotion.

future_semantic_admission_gate.minimum_non_circular_requirement: For semantic GWT/J-Space credit above mechanism-level re-entry evidence, predeclare a task/outcome semantic schema whose outcome is independently observable from downstream payload/readback and is not defined by intervention membership, broadcast presence, uptake occurrence, or re-entry occurrence itself.
future_semantic_admission_gate.discriminator: Matched intervention/control execution with identical task/input/context should compare that independent outcome under exact lineage. Equivalent semantic outcomes must fail closed to NO_SEMANTIC_CAUSAL_DIFFERENCE even when re-entry differs; only an independently observed task-semantic difference may remain a semantic-causal candidate.
future_semantic_admission_gate.promotion_rule: G8 can validly close the arm-label circularity and become stronger mechanism evidence, but it must not terminalize semantic GWT/J-Space admission by REENTRY_OBSERVED alone.

next_exact_action: Current WP900 G8 mutation owner should implement the independent witness/control binder and include the listed lineage/swap/factory regressions plus an explicit mechanism-vs-task-semantic scope fence. After repository CI, bind at most one exact G8 owner-VPS target subject. Do not promote semantic GWT/J-Space credit unless a later independent task-semantic discriminator executes and reconciles.
